product_overview: Resume Builder is a web-based backend API suite that enables template-driven resume creation, AI-powered content enhancement and scoring, and high-fidelity PDF export. It exposes endpoints for resume CRUD, AI assistants (enhance, summary, scoring, autofill, keywords), and HTML-to-PDF conversion.
core_goals: Provide a templates library and CRUD APIs for storing and retrieving resume data.
Offer AI-powered enhancement, summary, scoring, autofill, and keyword suggestions to improve resume quality and ATS compatibility.
Enable reliable, one-click PDF export that preserves on-screen formatting.
Support parsing uploads to accelerate resume creation and provide error-resilient handling for extraction/parsing failures.
Keep APIs simple and stateless so frontend clients can orchestrate flows (upload -> parse -> save -> enhance -> export).

features.name: Resume Management API
features.description: CRUD operations for resumes, upload-and-parse, and listing available resume templates.
user_flows: GET /api/resume/templates -> Receive 200 with List[TemplateConfigModel] (template thumbnails and config)
POST /api/resume/upload with file -> Receive 200 with ParsedResumeData -> POST /api/resume with ResumeDataModel -> Receive 200 with ResumeDataModel (happy path: upload, parse, create)
POST /api/resume/upload with corrupted file -> Receive 400 with Extraction error (error path: malformed upload)
GET /api/resume/{id} with valid id -> Receive 200 with ResumeDataModel (happy path: retrieve resume)
GET /api/resume/{id} with non-existent id -> Receive 404 Resume not found (error path: missing resource)
PUT /api/resume/{id} with updated ResumeDataModel and existing id -> Receive 200 with ResumeDataModel (happy path: update resume)
PUT /api/resume/{id} with updated ResumeDataModel and non-existent id -> Receive 404 Resume not found (error path: update missing record)
DELETE /api/resume/{id} with existing id -> Receive 200 ok (happy path: delete resume)
DELETE /api/resume/{id} with non-existent id -> Receive 404 Resume not found (error path: delete missing record)

features.name: AI Assistant API
features.description: AI-powered endpoints to enhance sections, generate summaries, score resumes, autofill sections from job descriptions, and suggest keywords.
user_flows: POST /api/ai/enhance with AIRequestModel (resume_id + section + text) -> Receive 200 with AIResponseModel (enhanced text) (happy path: section enhancement)
POST /api/ai/enhance with malformed AIRequestModel -> Receive 500 with error or 400 (error path: AI parsing/validation failure)
GET /api/resume/{id} with valid id -> Receive 200 with ResumeDataModel -> POST /api/ai/summary with ResumeDataModel -> Receive 200 with summary (happy path: generate summary from stored resume)
POST /api/ai/summary with incomplete resume_data -> Receive 200 with summary (but with warning) or 400 if input invalid (error path: insufficient data handling)
POST /api/ai/score with resume_data -> Receive 200 with score_data (happy path: resume scoring for ATS and completeness)
POST /api/ai/score with unsupported format -> Receive 400 or 500 with error (error path: scoring failure/invalid input)
POST /api/ai/autofill with {job_description, section_type} -> Receive 200 with autofill_data (happy path: generate section content from job description)
POST /api/ai/autofill with too-short job_description -> Receive 400 with validation error or 200 with low-confidence autofill (error path: insufficient JD content)
POST /api/ai/keywords with {job_title, industry} -> Receive 200 with keywords (happy path: keyword suggestions)
POST /api/ai/keywords with missing job_title -> Receive 400 with validation error (error path: missing required fields)

features.name: Export API
features.description: Convert user-generated HTML resume previews into downloadable PDF files while preserving formatting.
user_flows: GET /api/resume/{id} with valid id -> Receive 200 with ResumeDataModel -> POST /api/export/pdf with html (rendered from ResumeDataModel) -> Receive 200 with application/pdf (happy path: export resume to PDF)
POST /api/export/pdf with well-formed HTML string -> Receive 200 with application/pdf (direct export happy path)
POST /api/export/pdf with invalid or malicious HTML -> Receive 500 or 400 with parsing/render error (error path: PDF conversion failure)
